parameters.content:
## Create videos for a product catalog

### How it works
Select unfinished product rows, build one shared design, and submit a bulk render. Completed video links are matched back to their product rows. When all rows already have videos, finish successfully without rendering. Review each output before using it in a campaign.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it. On n8n Cloud, the owner can install verified **Zvid** from the Nodes panel.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets and select the same spreadsheet and tab in Get catalog rows and Write links to sheet.
4. Set brandName, website, colors and maxProducts in Config. Keep the batch size within your account’s limits.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Zvid installation guide](https://n8n.io/integrations/zvid/).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Prepare the product queue

Headers: Product, Price, CompareAtPrice, Feature1, Feature2, Feature3, ImageUrl1, ImageUrl2, CtaText, VideoUrl. Product must be unique; supply Price, ImageUrl1 and all three features. Leave VideoUrl empty for new renders. Completed catalogs exit successfully without spending credits.

## 3. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 4. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits.

## 5. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 6. Save the completed result

Write the completed URL back to its source row. Review the result before adding any further distribution steps.

## 7. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
